Name: (CP) Siamese Cat Replacement
Author: redriott
Description:
[center]this is a simple mod that changes the pet cat from an orange tabby to a siamese!
please tell me if there are any graphical errors or bugs you find!
(other graphical mods seen in preview screen caps are [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2694]ran's farm decor[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2050]eemie's map recolours[/url]﻿!)

[color=#cc4125]UPDATE AUG/22/19[/color]: i redid the Entire Spritesheet and also added the little pause menu icon, so now it looks Actually Good™

this mod requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿
simply unzip the folder into your mods folder to use![/center]

Downloads.Description: better sprites + pause menu icon !! install like any other content patcher mod
